# PCA tidyverse style

## Loading Libraries

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false

library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("cowplot")
```

## Load Data

The data is downloaded from wilkelab

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false

biopsy <- read_csv("https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv")
```

## Creating PCA fit variable

```{r}
print(biopsy)
```

```{r}
pca_fit <- biopsy |> 
  select(-outcome) |> 
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)
```

## Look at the data in PC coordinates 1

Using pca_fit results and combining them with outcome from biopsy.

```{r}
pca_fit
```

Object becomes a tibble when using augment:

```{r}
pca_fit %>%
  augment(biopsy)
```

```{r}
pca_fit |> 
  augment(biopsy) |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(.fittedPC1, .fittedPC2, color = outcome))+
    geom_point(size = 1)+
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(malignant ="black",benign = "green" )
      )+
      theme_half_open(12)+
      background_grid()
```
